title: Silicon Arena night shift — make the instrument harder to lie with
principle: Do not make Silicon Arena look successful. Make it increasingly difficult for Silicon Arena to lie.
queue: Static audit of any harness file not yet reviewed; fix only defects that can be demonstrated mechanically
Improve failure diagnostics: every void/refusal must name a specific cause, never a bucket
Artifact validation: a loader or checker for each artifact family, fail-closed
Test coverage: for each new test show positive control, sabotage control, proof the sabotage applied, and the correct failure reason
Documentation reproducibility: any procedure a future operator must follow should be executable, not prose

boundaries.lm_studio: READ-ONLY / DO-NOT-CONTACT. No restart, unload/load, inference, or experiment runs.
boundaries.frozen: Do not alter prereg history, quarantined evidence, ks/kh/n, or the 2048 MB floor
boundaries.commits: Never commit a failing tree; small verified units with descriptive messages

stop_when.DONE: queue exhausted and no further mechanically-justified work remains
stop_when.BLOCKED: cannot proceed without violating a boundary or without information that does not exist
stop_when.HUMAN_CLEARANCE_REQUIRED: next action needs runtime contact or a scientific judgement that is not the agent's to make
